additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
Reasons for the continues reboot and subsequent entering of FailsafeMode could be:
one of the FW components (PLC, Router, SECC, ...) is not reachable
RJ45 connector not properly connected on one of the devices
PLC not reachable (e.g. CFastCard corrupted) (Note: this would not notify FailsafeMode in the Error-Flags, since the PLC is not working in this case)
any software service failing to start

additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus Hellberg,
We have rebooted the charger & charger is healthy now.
For Failsafe Issue below are the points to be considered:
one of the FW components (PLC, Router, SECC, ...) is not reachable
RJ45 connector not properly connected on one of the devices
PLC not reachable (e.g. CFastCard corrupted) (Note: this would not notify FailsafeMode in the Error-Flags, since the PLC is not working in this case)
any software service failing to start
Note: as the issue is resolved we will proceed with closing the ticket.
